name: @triton-one/triton-sdk
description: Solana web3.js compatible SDK client for Triton One services

scripts.generate:proto: mkdir -p src/generated/grpc && protoc --plugin=protoc-gen-ts_proto=./node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-ts_proto --ts_proto_opt=forceLong=bigint --ts_proto_opt=outputServices=none --ts_proto_opt=esModuleInterop=true --experimental_allow_proto3_optional --ts_proto_out=src/generated/grpc -I ../yellowstone-account-sync-proto/proto -I ../yellowstone-account-sync-proto/proto/yellowstone-grpc/yellowstone-grpc-proto/proto geyser.proto solana-storage.proto && protoc --plugin=protoc-gen-ts_proto=./node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-ts_proto --ts_proto_opt=forceLong=bigint --ts_proto_opt=outputServices=grpc-js --ts_proto_opt=emitImportedFiles=false --ts_proto_opt=esModuleInterop=true --experimental_allow_proto3_optional --ts_proto_out=src/generated/grpc -I ../yellowstone-account-sync-proto/proto -I ../yellowstone-account-sync-proto/proto/yellowstone-grpc/yellowstone-grpc-proto/proto account_sync.proto
scripts.build: npm run generate:proto && npm run build:wasm && tsup && npm run copy:wasm
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path account-encoding-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm/account_encoding account-encoding-wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/yellowstone_account_sync_account_encoding_wasm.wasm
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:proto && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:types
scripts.test:live: npm run generate:proto && node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.live.config.ts
